Illaoi.escape: Just after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson, her mobility tool, is a window to close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. Dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit as well reduces the risk of getting caught. Volibear R Stormbringer has a telegraphed leap, so use it to engage when the enemy is already locked down or has no escape route.
Illaoi.build: Illaoi heals with P Prophet of an Elder God, so buy Executioner's Calling between core items to maintain Grievous Wounds. Build armor first to account for the damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Q Tentacle Smash, and W Harsh Lesson. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Illaoi.combo: When Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun her with an empowered basic attack.
Illaoi.fight: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit and start a fight immediately after you make her use W Harsh Lesson. Close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun her with an empowered basic attack; place Volibear E Sky Splitter at that location to deal damage and gain a shield. Don’t keep fighting near tentacles while Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the lane away from walls and last hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit range. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; look to trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. Before a fight, hit minions to build attack speed stacks for Volibear P The Relentless Storm.
Illaoi.phase: Volibear has strong melee trades early, but runs out of mana quickly, so keep fights short. In the late game, it’s hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul healing alone, so look for mid-game dives and objectives; don’t dive Illaoi near tentacles just because her health is low.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t group up where Illaoi R Leap of Faith can hit multiple champions, and back away for its duration once it’s used. If you can’t destroy the tentacles, draw Illaoi into open ground away from walls. After an ally starts a fight and the enemy has used their abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer or Q Thundering Smash while your Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks are built.
Illaoi.watch: Prioritize dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit. If you can fight after your spirit is pulled, fight back; when you choose not to fight, break the link and then dodge the first tentacle. While Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, don’t fight near tentacles; back away.

DrMundo.fight: Trade when Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and Volibear Q Thundering Smash is available. Build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm in advance, stun him with Q, then mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, weave in basic attacks, and heal when you use W again. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, don’t fixate on securing a kill.
DrMundo.build: Dr. Mundo’s main ability, E Blunt Force Trauma, deals physical damage, so build armor first. If the healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, Q Infected Bonesaw, and W Heart Zapper prolongs the duel, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
DrMundo.combo: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, it ignores the first stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash. Trigger his passive, then look to fight again once Q is ready. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter on the Q stun to deal damage and slow him, and gain a shield.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases going down is your chance to close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw was blocked by a minion or missed, you can approach without being slowed.
DrMundo.laning: Keep minions between you and Dr. Mundo to block Q Infected Bonesaw, and farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul while managing your mana. Trade when the enemy wave pushes toward your turret, giving you room to hold him close, and Volibear Q Thundering Smash is available. After trading, step on the canister dropped by Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases as you retreat to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, but save mana before you learn several abilities. In the late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone, so secure an advantage in the mid game.
DrMundo.teamfight: After an ally starts a fight, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer as the enemy uses their abilities and lock down a damage dealer. Fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in. If the enemies are spread out, save R and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, shift your focus to another target instead of chasing Mundo for too long.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target and deals damage based on current health, so stand behind minions, especially when your health is high. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don’t rely on Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun to engage while his passive is available. Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage increases his healing and movement speed, so don’t waste time chasing him.

Aatrox.laning: In the early game, collect CS without giving Aatrox a kill. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; look to trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. You have a better trading setup when the enemy wave pushes toward your turret, giving you room to hold Aatrox close for longer.
Aatrox.teamfight: Wait for an ally to start a fight and for Aatrox and the enemy team to use their abilities before engaging. Build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm, then leap in with Volibear R Stormbringer when there’s an opening to reach the backline and lock down a damage dealer with Q Thundering Smash. If there’s no good angle to engage, save R and hold the frontline with Q.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and W Infernal Chains. If Aatrox’s healing prolongs the duel, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items to keep Grievous Wounds up with Volibear’s basic attacks and W Frenzied Maul. Consider penetration on damage items because Aatrox has high armor.
Aatrox.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, approach, and stun Aatrox with an empowered basic attack once in range, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Follow up with basic attacks, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the marked Aatrox to deal damage and heal. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stunned target, and stand in the blast radius if you need the shield.
Aatrox.escape: Just after Aatrox E Umbral Dash is used, you have a chance to close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. Use Volibear R Stormbringer to engage when Aatrox is already locked down or has no escape route.
Aatrox.fight: Trade when Aatrox’s empowered basic attack from P Deathbringer Stance is used on a minion and Aatrox E Umbral Dash is also down. Close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, avoiding the edge of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade as you get close. Keep your distance while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, but Aatrox can snowball from an early lead, so don’t overcommit and give him a kill. In the mid game, build an advantage with dives and objectives. In the late game, don’t expect Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone to keep you alive through defensive items and Grievous Wounds.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is dangerous when it hits with the blade’s edge, so watch the cast animation and dodge out of range or move in close. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, walk out of its area immediately. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, stop fighting and reengage after it expires.

Sion.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, but must conserve mana before learning several abilities. In mid game, as Volibear W Frenzied Maul ranks up and you learn Volibear R Stormbringer, get an advantage with fights and dives. As the game goes on, Sion increases his max health through CS, while Volibear is affected by enemy armor and healing reduction, so play to avoid dragging the game out.
Sion.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. It's also important to dodge Sion E Roar of the Slayer, which reduces your armor when it hits. Stacking health alone also increases the max-health-based damage from Sion P Glory in Death, and healing reduction is useful against revived Sion.
Sion.combo: After dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach to stun him with the empowered attack. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to mark him and a basic attack, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the same target. Time Volibear E Sky Splitter with the stun and stand in the blast radius to gain a shield.
Sion.escape: If you've dodged Sion Q Decimating Smash or made him use it early, engage while the risk of a stun or knock-up is reduced.
Sion.fight: Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side or make him use it early, then close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun him. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, focus your damage to break the shield quickly and prevent the explosion. Use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the same target for damage and healing.
Sion.laning: Trade when the enemy wave is pushing toward your tower and Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready. In general, farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to manage your mana, and save its first cast for Sion if a fight is likely. If Sion keeps farming, his max health will increase, so push the lane to disrupt his farm or get an advantage elsewhere.
Sion.teamfight: After an ally starts a fight and the enemy uses their abilities, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer and catch a carry. If you stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm beforehand, you can also deal damage to nearby enemies. Dodge Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught to the side, and reposition where Sion falls until Sion P Glory in Death ends.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash knocks you up and stuns you if he charges it for a long time, so dodge to the side. Don't face Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; dodge to the side of his charge. After taking Sion down, immediately create distance because Sion P Glory in Death revives him and lets him attack quickly.

Quinn.build: Quinn's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. Magic resistance will not help against her damage.
Quinn.combo: When Quinn E Vault is down, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash to approach and stun her with the empowered attack. Place Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stun, then mark her with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, weave in basic attacks, and recast W for damage and healing.
Quinn.escape: The opening to engage is right after Quinn E Vault is down. Close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, and use Volibear R Stormbringer to close the gap when Quinn has no escape route.
Quinn.fight: Close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash right after Quinn E Vault is down. If you can build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm before engaging, it will help in the trade.
Quinn.laning: Early on, stay out of Quinn's range, preserve your health, and collect CS. Poke with Volibear E Sky Splitter, but do not use it excessively; save mana and the shield for the right engage.
Quinn.phase: Quinn's range and poke are difficult early, so preserve your health and wait for an opportunity when Quinn E Vault is down. Volibear can look for dives and objectives in the mid game, when W is stronger and he has R, but late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on W's healing alone.
Quinn.teamfight: Start team fights instead of facing Quinn alone in a side lane. Once your allies engage and the enemy has used their abilities, go in with Volibear R Stormbringer; catch Quinn when she approaches from the flank with the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, step out of range to avoid her empowered attack. Quinn E Vault knocks away and slows Volibear when he is on top of her, so do not force an engage before it is down.

Aurora.combo: If Aurora’s mobility abilities are down, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, approach, and stun her with an empowered basic attack once in range, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Cast Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stunned target and follow up with basic attacks, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the same target to heal. Use Volibear R Stormbringer to start a leap when Aurora is already locked down or has no escape route.
Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on max health and provides healing, so prioritize magic resistance over stacking health alone. If the healing is a problem, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Aurora.escape: If only one of Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding is down, she can escape with the other, so wait until she has used both before engaging. While Aurora is stealthed with W Across the Veil, don’t waste abilities into empty space; place Volibear E Sky Splitter where she’ll reappear.
Aurora.fight: Look to engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash after both Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are down. Build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm by hitting minions before going in, and trade just after Aurora uses a poke ability. Aim Volibear E Sky Splitter at the stun location from Volibear Q Thundering Smash to deal damage and gain a shield.
Aurora.laning: Against ranged Aurora, don’t use Volibear Q Thundering Smash for a reckless engage; farm CS and poke with Volibear E Sky Splitter. Trade when Aurora steps forward or just after she uses a poke ability, ideally catching her near your turret. Volibear E Sky Splitter costs a lot of mana and has a long cooldown, so save it for an engage opportunity.
Aurora.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, but engaging without being able to reach Aurora only wastes mana, so wait for the right opening. In the late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone, so secure an advantage in the mid game with dives and objectives.
Aurora.teamfight: After an ally starts a fight and Aurora uses a mobility ability, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer and lock down a damage dealer. Build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in, and look for an opening after Aurora uses Aurora W Across the Veil to engage and fails to secure a takedown. When retreating, don’t leave low-health allies behind, reducing Aurora’s chance to reengage.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and its recall damage increases as your health gets lower. If you’re cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and you, and if you’re below half health, retreat before the recall. After Aurora R Between Worlds creates its zone, you’ll be slowed when leaving it, so decide whether to escape before it appears or fight inside.

Malphite.watch: Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash, so Volibear Q Thundering Smash's stun can't interrupt it. When you can't see Malphite, don't group with allies near walls or bushes. Don't start a trade right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.build: Buy magic resistance first against the magic damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Malphite W Thunderclap deals physical damage, so magic resistance won't block it. Bypass Malphite's high armor with the max-health-based damage from Volibear E Sky Splitter.
Malphite.combo: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and close in. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter during the stun and stand in its blast radius to get the shield.
Malphite.escape: At that point, close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, and use Volibear R Stormbringer if needed to close the gap. Delay your engage right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then trade when you can damage his actual health. If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, don't engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash while slowed. If Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Malphite.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana. Trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is available. Poke at short intervals so Malphite P Granite Shield doesn't regenerate.
Malphite.phase: In mid game, use the turret disable from Volibear R Stormbringer to secure your lead with dives and objectives.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't knock several of you up. After his ultimate is down and the enemy has used their abilities, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer and pin down a carry. Build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in.

Olaf.phase: Olaf is strongest early, so avoid giving up a kill and don’t force close-range fights. In the mid game, Volibear W Frenzied Maul is empowered, and you have Volibear R Stormbringer; use that power for dives and objectives. Olaf is relatively weaker late, but it also becomes harder for Volibear to survive on healing alone with W, so make the most of your mid-game opportunities.
Olaf.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, which resistances cannot reduce, so build health too. Since much of his damage comes from basic attacks, lowering his attack speed can also help.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach to stun him with an empowered basic attack. Then apply a mark with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, weave in basic attacks, and use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the same target. Time Volibear E Sky Splitter to land during the stun, and stay within its blast radius to gain the shield.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no skill that lets him create distance on his own, so engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash when Olaf Q Undertow misses and recovering the axe becomes difficult.
Olaf.fight: If Olaf Q Undertow misses and he is left in a position where recovering the axe is difficult, close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and trade. Apply a mark with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, weave in basic attacks, then use it again on the same target for damage and healing. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and wait out its duration instead of standing and fighting.
Olaf.laning: When Olaf throws his axe, move in the opposite direction from where it lands to make it harder for him to recover Olaf Q Undertow and approach. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready. Look for a situation where the enemy wave pushes toward your turret, so you can keep Olaf nearby for longer.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows you and reduces your armor when it hits, so move away from where the axe lands. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, Volibear Q Thundering Smash cannot stun him, so create some distance and use it after Ragnarok ends.
Olaf.teamfight: After your team starts a fight and the enemy uses their abilities, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer and pin down a carry. Don't use Volibear Q Thundering Smash's stun on Olaf while Olaf R Ragnarok is active; use it after Ragnarok ends. Enter with stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm to also damage nearby enemies.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical and relies on critical strikes, so build armor first. Thornmail, which blocks basic attacks, is also a good fit against him. If the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust is a problem, slot Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Tryndamere.combo: When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is used, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach to stun him with an empowered basic attack. Then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul and weave in basic attacks, followed by another Volibear W Frenzied Maul on Tryndamere while the mark remains. Time Volibear E Sky Splitter to land during the stun to deal damage, slow him, and gain the shield.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after you make Tryndamere use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is your chance to close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, it reduces your attack damage, so don’t immediately commit to a basic-attack fight. Engage after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down and the effect of Tryndamere W Mocking Shout has worn off.
Tryndamere.fight: It’s good to engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun Tryndamere just after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is used. Apply a mark with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, weave in basic attacks, then use it again on the same target for damage and healing. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, manage your distance and wait out its duration, then deal damage again.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere to keep him from stacking Fury with last hits. When he starts building Fury by hitting minions, create distance. If the enemy wave has pushed toward your turret and Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready, trade. When backing away, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.phase: Volibear has strong close-range trades early, and it’s best to harass Tryndamere before he builds Fury. Late game, healing reduction and defensive items make it hard to survive on healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul alone.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Don’t try to stop Tryndamere alone in a side lane when Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready; trade for an objective or take him down with several allies. In team fights, wait for an ally to engage and the enemy to use their abilities, then dive in with Volibear R Stormbringer. If Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, stun him with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, wait out its duration.
Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere P Battle Fury stacks up, his critical strikes become dangerous and Tryndamere Q Bloodlust heals for more. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash has its cooldown reduced whenever he critically strikes, so don’t chase him where there are lots of minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he cannot be killed, so don’t commit all your damage; buy time with the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash or create distance.

Akali.build: Build magic resistance first against Akali’s damage. Also build health to withstand the second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution.
Akali.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach, then stun Akali with an empowered basic attack once in range. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to mark her, weave in basic attacks, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the same target to deal damage and heal.
Akali.escape: Don’t chase immediately just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. Check the status of Akali’s escape tools, including Akali E Shuriken Flip and R Perfect Execution, and close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or R Stormbringer especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up.
Akali.fight: Close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, stun Akali with an empowered basic attack, and cast Volibear E Sky Splitter on that spot to deal damage and gain a shield.
Akali.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. Look for an opportunity when the enemy wave pushes toward your turret, letting you hold Akali close for longer. Build a health and CS lead while Akali’s ultimate is unavailable.
Akali.phase: Once Volibear learns R Stormbringer, cement your mid-game advantage with dives and objectives. In the late game, enemy defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it difficult to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone.
Akali.teamfight: After your allies start a fight, confirm that Akali's mobility options have been spent, then engage with Volibear R Stormbringer. Before going in, hit minions or jungle monsters to fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm. If the enemy team is spread out, save your ultimate and hold the frontline by closing in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip. Once marked, you can’t escape the second dash even by running away. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, and its second hit gets stronger based on your missing health, so be especially careful when low.

Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille’s main damage. Resistances don’t work against the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, but Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. If the healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep is a problem, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Camille.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach, then stun Camille with an empowered basic attack once in range. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to mark Camille, weave in basic attacks, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the same target. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stun and stand in its blast radius to gain a shield.
Camille.escape: Camille E Hookshot going down is your chance to close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. Check that Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is also down before going in to reduce the chance of her escaping with another mobility ability. If Camille E Hookshot interrupts Volibear Q Thundering Smash, use the reset cooldown to close in again.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield; close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash once the shield has been removed. When you can reengage, use Volibear W Frenzied Maul twice on the same target to gain healing and empowered damage.
Camille.laning: Stand among minions and away from walls to limit Camille E Hookshot’s engage angles. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; look to trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. Take lane control and pressure Camille’s farming before she completes her first core item.
Camille.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, and Camille is weak before her first core item, so pressure her farming. In the mid game, use the power from an upgraded Volibear W Frenzied Maul and learning Volibear R Stormbringer to secure an advantage with dives and objectives. In the late game, it’s hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone, and Camille destroys side-lane turrets quickly, so don’t leave a side lane unattended.
Camille.teamfight: After an ally starts a fight and Camille and the rest of the enemy team have used their abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer. Fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in so you can damage nearby enemies too. If the enemy team isn’t spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the frontline by closing in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from long range and stun you, so stand away from walls and don’t let yourself get pushed toward one. Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum makes her untargetable as she leaps in, so don’t waste Volibear Q Thundering Smash during that moment.

Chogath.build: Build magic resistance first against Cho’Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. If the healing from Cho’Gath P Carnivore is a problem, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items. Cho’Gath R Feast deals true damage, so magic resistance can’t mitigate it.
Chogath.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, approach, and stun Cho’Gath with an empowered basic attack, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Weave in basic attacks and use W again. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter on the Q stun to deal damage and slow him, and stand in the blast radius to gain a shield.
Chogath.escape: Engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash just after Cho’Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave or you dodge its warning. Cho’Gath has no mobility ability, so once you get close, he has no way to create distance; still, avoid the frontal silence from Cho’Gath W Feral Scream as you approach.
Chogath.fight: Fight after dodging the warning for Cho’Gath Q Rupture or just after he uses Q on the wave, closing in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. Approach from outside the frontal area of Cho’Gath W Feral Scream, then mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and use W again to deal damage and heal.
Chogath.laning: Push or pressure the lane from the early game to limit Cho’Gath’s time to scale. Don’t stand in the line of Cho’Gath E Vorpal Spikes behind minions; farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana. Look to trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up and the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret.
Chogath.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee fights, so pressure Cho’Gath’s scaling. In the mid game, cement your advantage with dives and objectives using Volibear R Stormbringer. Cho’Gath’s stacks make the matchup harder as the game goes on, and in the late game it’s difficult to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone.
Chogath.teamfight: After an ally starts a fight and the enemy team has used its abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer and lock down a damage dealer. Fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in so you’re ready to damage nearby enemies too. If the enemy team isn’t spread out, save R and hold the frontline by closing in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Chogath.watch: When the warning for Cho’Gath Q Rupture appears beneath you, walk sideways to dodge it. If Cho’Gath W Feral Scream silences you, it will be hard to dodge the Q that follows, so move out of its frontal area. If you’re at half health or less, retreat beyond the range of Cho’Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius’s main damage, but also get health to account for the penetration on Darius E Apprehend and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine. To reduce the healing from Darius Q Decimate, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items. Against Darius’s high armor, add penetration or use the max-health damage from Volibear E Sky Splitter.
Darius.combo: Fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm in advance. When Darius E Apprehend is down, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stun and enter its blast radius to gain a shield.
Darius.escape: Engage after Darius E Apprehend misses or while he waits for it to come back up. Save a mobility ability before going in so you can respond to Darius E Apprehend.
Darius.fight: After Darius E Apprehend misses or goes down, close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash for a short trade. Avoid the blade’s edge of Darius Q Decimate, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the marked target to deal damage and heal. If stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage start building, disengage and look for another opening after they expire.
Darius.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; look to trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. A good opportunity is when the enemy wave pushes toward your turret, giving you room to chase for longer. If Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions, punish him, but stay outside the range of Darius E Apprehend while it’s available.
Darius.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades but runs out of mana quickly, while Darius is strong in early skirmishes, so keep trades short. In the late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it difficult to fight for long on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone.
Darius.teamfight: After an ally starts a fight and the enemy team has used its abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer and lock down a damage dealer. Fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in. If the enemy team is grouped up, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If you’re low while Darius P Hemorrhage is stacked, get out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine to prevent a kill with it from causing a chain of damage.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with a basic attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so wait outside its range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s edge or hug him to reduce his healing. If stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage build up, create distance. If you’re low while stacked, get completely outside the range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against Fiora Q Lunge and E Bladework. If the healing from Fiora P Duelist’s Dance and R Grand Challenge becomes a problem in a prolonged fight, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Fiora.combo: Once Fiora W Riposte is down, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, approach, and stun her with an empowered basic attack. Time Volibear E Sky Splitter to overlap with that stun, then mark her with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, weave in basic attacks, and use W again on the same target.
Fiora.escape: Just after baiting out Fiora Q Lunge, close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or R Stormbringer. If Fiora W Riposte is still available, don’t rush to stun her with Volibear Q Thundering Smash; engage during the opening after Riposte goes down.
Fiora.fight: Bait out Fiora W Riposte and move sideways to dodge the counterthrust, then close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun her. The moment after Fiora Q Lunge goes down is also a chance to close the gap; after a short trade, don’t chase too far.
Fiora.laning: Stand on the side opposite your exposed vital and punish Fiora when she approaches it. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; trade when the enemy wave pushes toward your turret and you can catch Fiora with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Fiora.phase: In the mid game, cement your advantage with dives and objectives.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash and can stun you in return, so don’t use Q’s empowered basic attack while Riposte is available. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, hug a wall to cover one of your vital sides.
Fiora.teamfight: After an ally starts a fight and the enemy team has used its abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer and lock down a damage dealer. If an ally is hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, have them hug a wall so they don’t expose all four vitals.

Gangplank.build: Build armor first in lane to withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley poke and E Powder Keg damage. If fights drag on because of Gangplank W Remove Scurvy, buy Executioner's Calling between core items to keep Grievous Wounds applied with basic attacks and Volibear W Frenzied Maul.
Gangplank.combo: If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, approach, and stun him with an empowered basic attack, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul and basic attacks. Recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the same target while the mark remains to deal damage and heal, and time Volibear E Sky Splitter with the stun.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no skill to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash just after he places E Powder Keg or a keg is destroyed. Use the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash while Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, and don’t force your way into the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg or R Cannon Barrage.
Gangplank.fight: When Gangplank has just placed E Powder Keg and it hasn’t matured yet, get close and trade. Once Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, land the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash and keep attacking without worrying that the crowd control will be cleansed.
Gangplank.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; look to trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. A good opening is when the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret and Gangplank has just placed E Powder Keg. Back away first if there’s a mature keg nearby.
Gangplank.phase: Volibear has strong melee trades early, but runs out of mana quickly, so pick short windows to fight before Gangplank E Powder Keg matures. In the mid game, Volibear W Frenzied Maul is stronger and learning R Stormbringer gives you power to look for dives and objectives; check whether Gangplank has used R Cannon Barrage. In the late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul healing alone, so make the most of your mid-game opportunities.
Gangplank.teamfight: After an ally starts a fight and the enemy has used their abilities, enter the back line with Volibear R Stormbringer once your passive stacks are full. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, lock him down with the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash and follow up with Volibear W Frenzied Maul. If the enemy team is spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the front with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg slows when it explodes after maturing, so back away if there’s a mature keg nearby and destroy it from a safe distance.

Garen.build: Build armor first to withstand the main damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage based on your missing health, so don’t rely on resistances alone; build up your total health too. If healing from Garen P Perseverance is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Garen.combo: Once Garen Q Decisive Strike has been expended, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and run at him, stunning with an empowered basic attack in range. Recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on Garen while the mark remains to deal damage and heal, and time Volibear E Sky Splitter with the stun.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility skill, so engage after his Garen Q Decisive Strike empowered basic attack has been used and Garen W Courage’s brief tenacity window has passed. Close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun him; don’t stay on him for long while Garen E Judgment is spinning.
Garen.fight: Close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash for a brief trade just after Garen uses Q Decisive Strike on a minion or his empowered basic attack has been consumed. Look for trades where you can recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the same target to deal damage and heal.
Garen.laning: Pressure Garen from the early game so he has no chance to build stacks for Garen W Courage. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. If the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret, it’s easier to catch Garen; if you’ve pushed the lane hard, expose him to a gank or create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
Garen.phase: Volibear is strong in melee trades early, so pressure Garen before he builds stacks. As the game goes on, Garen’s permanent stacks put you at a disadvantage, and it becomes harder to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul healing alone, so secure your lead with mid-game dives and objectives.
Garen.teamfight: After an ally starts a fight and the enemy has used their abilities, enter the back line with Volibear R Stormbringer and lock down a carry. Fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in so you can damage nearby enemies too. If the enemy team is spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash to hold the frontline.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack silences you and prevents you from fighting back, so don’t engage first while it’s active. Garen W Courage grants a shield and tenacity right after use, so delay the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash by half a beat. Don’t stay in the area of Garen E Judgment for long, and if you’re below half health, stay out of Garen R Demacian Justice range.

Gnar.build: Gnar’s Q, E, and R mostly deal physical damage, so build armor first. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. If it’s hard to avoid Gnar R GNAR!’s stun when pushed into a wall, consider tenacity as well.
Gnar.combo: To engage, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, approach, and stun with an empowered basic attack, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Keep basic attacking and use W a second time on Gnar while the mark remains. If you time Volibear E Sky Splitter with the Q stun, it deals damage and slows, and you can also gain a shield inside its area.
Gnar.escape: Just after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down is a window to close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. Hold your engage when Gnar’s Rage is high and his transformation is near, or while Mega Gnar still has crowd control available. Engage just after he returns to Mini Gnar, while he can’t transform again.
Gnar.fight: Look to engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash just after Mini Gnar uses E Hop / Crunch. Back away just after Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar, then look for an all-in while he is Mini Gnar again and unable to build Rage. Once you’re on him, keep the mark from Volibear W Frenzied Maul and use the second W for damage and healing.
Gnar.laning: While taking ranged poke, use Volibear E Sky Splitter to poke back and farm CS; don’t use Q to force an engage. Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach when Gnar’s poke abilities are down or he steps forward. Trade when the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret and you can stay on him for a while.
Gnar.phase: Volibear is strong once he gets on a target early, but if Mini Gnar’s ranged poke keeps you back, farm near your turret and wait for an opening. In the mid game, when Volibear W Frenzied Maul is stronger and you have learned R Stormbringer, watch Gnar’s transformation cycle and look for dives and objectives. In the late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to rely on W healing alone, so make the most of your mid-game opportunities.
Gnar.teamfight: Track Gnar’s Rage and start fights when he can’t transform again, such as just after he returns from Mega Gnar to Mini Gnar. Avoid positions with your back to a wall and narrow terrain to reduce Gnar R GNAR!’s stun angles. After an ally starts a fight and the enemy has used their abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer or Q Thundering Smash and lock down a carry.
Gnar.watch: The boomerang from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit you on its return too, so step out of its path. Avoid direct fights as Gnar’s Rage builds and his transformation approaches. Against Mega Gnar, don’t stand with your back to a wall, so you avoid giving Gnar R GNAR! an angle to stun you.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first, with an item like Spectre's Cowl, to withstand Gwen’s main damage. Her basic attacks also deal physical damage, so get some armor too, and fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter her healing. Gwen has high armor, which reduces Volibear’s main physical damage, so consider penetration as well.
Gwen.combo: When Gwen W Hallowed Mist ends or you can enter the mist, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, approach, and stun her with an empowered basic attack. Recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on Gwen while the mark remains to deal damage and heal.
Gwen.escape: The window to engage is immediately after you make Gwen use E Skip 'n Slash. Close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash then, and leap in with Volibear R Stormbringer when Gwen is locked down or has no escape route. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash comes back more easily where there are many minions, so draw her into an area without minions and fight there.
Gwen.fight: Trade after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down and before Gwen Q Snip Snip! has built up stacks. Close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, stun her, and place Volibear E Sky Splitter on her to deal damage and gain a shield. When Gwen uses Q Snip Snip!, don’t stand in the center and trade; step to the side.
Gwen.laning: Early on, stay outside Gwen’s basic attack range so she can’t heal, then trade before Gwen Q Snip Snip! builds stacks. Otherwise, farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; fight when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. A good opening is when the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret and you can stay on Gwen for a while.
Gwen.phase: Volibear has strong melee trades early, and your opening is before Gwen Q Snip Snip! builds stacks. In the late game, the enemy’s defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul healing alone.
Gwen.teamfight: Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and R Needlework deal damage based on maximum health, so build magic resistance along with health rather than stacking health alone. After an ally starts a fight and the enemy has used their abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer and lock down a carry. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!; if the enemy team isn’t spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the front with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!'s cone deals true damage, so move sideways to avoid it. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target Gwen from outside the mist, so enter it or wait until it ends. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is easier to recast if it hits a minion, so be especially careful when chasing her through a wave.

Irelia.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and W Defiant Dance. Since basic attacks and attack speed are also a major part of her damage, reducing her attack speed is effective. If healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Irelia.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach, stunning Irelia with an empowered basic attack in range. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to mark her, weave in basic attacks, then recast W on Irelia while the mark remains. Place Volibear E Sky Splitter on her with the stun and stand in its blast radius to get the shield.
Irelia.escape: Just after you make Irelia use Q Bladesurge is a window to close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, it’s a good time to engage. If Irelia is already locked down or has no escape route, land with Volibear R Stormbringer and then catch her with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Irelia.fight: Just after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down is a good trade window: close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun her. Mark her with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, weave in basic attacks, then recast it on the same target for damage and healing. Time Volibear E Sky Splitter with the stun to deal damage and gain a shield.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and watch for her chained engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge when minions are about to die. Manage your mana and trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up if the enemy wave is pushing and you can hold her near your turret.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul healing alone.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and E Flawless Duet have a large impact in teamfights, so focus Irelia first. After an ally starts a fight and the enemy has used their abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer and fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm to damage nearby enemies too. If the formation isn’t spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the front with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain onto low-health minions to close the gap, so back away when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet; if you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge’s barrier, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: Jax’s damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so prioritize items that reduce his attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, approach, and stun him with an empowered basic attack. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to mark him, then place Volibear E Sky Splitter with the stun; weave in basic attacks and recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the same target.
Jax.escape: Just after Jax Q Leap Strike is used is an opportunity to close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or R Stormbringer. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, don’t rush your engage; wait outside the stun range for its duration to end.
Jax.fight: Trade when Jax E Counter Strike is down and Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready. If Jax has also used Q Leap Strike, close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun him, then recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the same target for damage and healing.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in level 1 melee trades, so don’t force yourself into melee range. While Jax E Counter Strike is down, pressure him with your jungler to build a CS and level lead.
Jax.phase: In the late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul healing alone.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with E Counter Strike active, don’t group up around him; wait for the area stun to end. Then catch Jax with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, or, after an ally starts a fight and the enemy has used their abilities, enter the back line with Volibear R Stormbringer.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, it dodges even the basic attack carrying Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun, so don’t basic attack him. Step out of range to avoid the recast’s area stun, then fight after Counter Strike ends.

Jayce.build: Buy an item that builds magic resistance first. Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone, and get movement speed to leave the telegraphed attack area.
Jayce.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, approach, and stun Jayce with an empowered basic attack in range, then follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, a basic attack, and a second Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Time Volibear E Sky Splitter with the stun to aim for damage and a shield.
Jayce.escape: Just after Jayce Q To the Skies! is down is a window to engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Jayce E Thundering Blow is down too, it’s a good time to go in because there’s less risk of being knocked back once you’re on him.
Jayce.fight: Close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash when Jayce Q To the Skies!'s leap is down or immediately after he uses a poke ability. If Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is still available, keep it in mind; once you’re on him, maintain Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s mark through the second cast.
Jayce.laning: When Jayce is holding his cannon, move side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast and farm CS while poking with Volibear E Sky Splitter. Use Volibear Q Thundering Smash to engage only when Jayce steps forward or immediately after he uses a poke ability; if health has dropped substantially, don’t force yourself to stay in lane.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strongest early, so if you start falling behind, farm defensively and wait for Volibear to scale. In the late game, the enemy’s defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul healing alone.
Jayce.teamfight: Engage after an ally starts a fight and Jayce has used his abilities. If Jayce Q To the Skies!'s leap is down, catch him with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or R Stormbringer. Fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may be coming, so sidestep out of its straight path. When Jayce is holding his hammer, watch out for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Kayle.build: Build magic resistance first against Kayle's damage. It's also important to dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast, since it lowers your resistances when it hits. Volibear's physical damage is effective against Kayle's low armor.
Kayle.combo: Immediately before a fight, hit minions to fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm. Run in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun Kayle with an empowered basic attack, then place Volibear E Sky Splitter at that location and use Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Follow with basic attacks, then recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on Kayle while she is marked to deal damage and heal.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, so after she uses the movement speed boost from Kayle W Celestial Blessing is a good window to catch her. Dodge the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, then close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun her. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is already down, it’s a good time to engage and focus your damage.
Kayle.fight: Close in and stun Kayle when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready, then place Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stun to use its slow and shield. After Kayle R Divine Judgment is down, get back on her and focus your damage.
Kayle.laning: Take lane control early and widen the gap by denying Kayle CS and experience. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana. When the enemy wave pushes toward your turret, catch Kayle with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Kayle.phase: In mid game, dive with your jungler and consolidate your lead through objectives and turrets.
Kayle.teamfight: After your team starts a fight and Kayle uses her abilities, find a route to reach her from the flank or out of vision. Engage with Volibear R Stormbringer or catch her with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, timing it with your team's crowd control. If Kayle R Divine Judgment activates, use the stun to run down its duration and attack after the damage immunity ends.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces armor and magic resistance, so avoid taking a direct hit when engaging. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so be careful when your health is low. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don't dump your damage into her; stun her with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and let the damage immunity expire.

Kennen.build: Kennen's main abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance early. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm repeatedly interrupts your engages with its stun, consider Quicksilver Sash.
Kennen.combo: When you can get onto Kennen, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, stun him with an empowered basic attack, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul.
Kennen.escape: Kennen E Lightning Rush is his main escape, so immediately after he uses it is an opportunity to engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has two stacks on you, back off first and go in once they disappear.
Kennen.fight: Close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down or when Kennen steps forward. After stunning him, mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, then use W again before backing away to deal damage and heal.
Kennen.laning: Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and step forward only briefly to last-hit. Usually, poke and farm with Volibear E Sky Splitter, and look to fight when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down.
Kennen.phase: Early on, Volibear is strong in close-range trades once he gets on top of his opponent, but conserve mana before you learn several abilities. In mid game, after learning Volibear R Stormbringer, use its turret disable to look for dives and objectives. Later, enemy defensive items and healing reduction make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone.
Kennen.teamfight: Don't stand close to allies, so Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom can't stun several of you at once, and use vision to track where Kennen might enter. After your team starts a fight and Kennen uses his abilities, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer and pin down a carry.
Kennen.watch: Kennen stuns you after three stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm, so if you have two marks, step back briefly and wait for them to disappear. Dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and when Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom is active, create distance to avoid its area stun.

Kled.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting. Armor won't block the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and stacking health alone also increases damage based on maximum health.
Kled.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, close in, and stun Kled with an empowered basic attack. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and a basic attack, then recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul while the mark remains. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stunned Kled, and stand in the blast radius to get the shield.
Kled.escape: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, get out before it pulls you in. Create distance to avoid Kled W Violent Tendencies' chain of attacks as well. Look for a chance to get back on him with Volibear Q Thundering Smash after Kled E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down.
Kled.fight: Trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready and you can dodge Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth attack. Mark Kled with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, then recast it to deal damage and heal. If Kled dismounts, watch his Courage meter and only chase if you can finish him.
Kled.laning: Farm with W and manage your mana. Look for a good chance to catch Kled with Volibear Q Thundering Smash when the enemy wave is pushed toward your turret. If you dismount Kled, push him away from the lane so he can't build Courage by killing minions.
Kled.phase: Early on, manage Volibear's mana while respecting fights where Kled has his full set of abilities available and watching for his remount. In mid game, use the strength of Volibear W Frenzied Maul being strengthened and R Stormbringer being learned to look for dives and objectives. Kled falls off after lane and mid game, but later Volibear also struggles to survive on W's healing alone against enemy defensive items and healing reduction.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flanks to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s long-range engage. If you can't stop it, stand in front so your back line isn't hit directly. After your team starts a fight and the enemy uses their abilities, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer and pin down a carry.
Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope hits you, create distance before it pulls you in. Kled W Violent Tendencies' fourth attack deals a burst of damage based on your max health, so don't stay on top of him while his attack speed is increased.

KSante.build: Build some penetration to counter K'Sante's high armor. Get armor against his main damage, and build health against the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker.
KSante.combo: Watch for K'Sante W Path Maker's charge and dodge to the side. Then activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, close in, and stun him with an empowered basic attack. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter during the stun, then attack with Volibear W Frenzied Maul → basic attack → recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the same target. If K'Sante's escape is down and you're fighting under a turret, land with Volibear R Stormbringer, then follow up with Volibear Q Thundering Smash → Volibear W Frenzied Maul → Volibear E Sky Splitter.
KSante.escape: Don't go in just because K'Sante W Path Maker is down. Close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash when K'Sante E Footwork is also down, or before K'Sante R All Out comes back, and after you've dodged the empowered shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Use Volibear R Stormbringer when K'Sante's mobility is down and he can't easily avoid your landing.
KSante.fight: Dodge the empowered shockwave from K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, then close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash after K'Sante W Path Maker's charge ends. Use Volibear E Sky Splitter during the stun, and recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the same target to deal damage and heal. When K'Sante R All Out is active, exploit his reduced defenses, but don't take on his increased damage and life steal alone in a prolonged fight.
KSante.laning: After that, farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana. Trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up and the enemy wave is pushed toward your turret. Before a fight, hit minions to build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm.
KSante.phase: Later in the game, K'Sante's defensive items and healing reduction make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone, so make use of your strong mid-game window.
KSante.teamfight: After your team starts a fight and K'Sante uses his abilities, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer and pin down an enemy carry. Build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in. If the enemy team is spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the front with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If you have to fight K'Sante while K'Sante R All Out is active for a long time, make sure at least one teammate has a way to apply healing reduction, and prevent K'Sante from hitting several people to heal.
KSante.watch: If you get hit by K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes in succession, step out of range to avoid the pull and stun from the next shockwave. While K'Sante W Path Maker is charging, he gains unstoppable and damage reduction, so save Volibear Q Thundering Smash's stun and dodge to the side of his charge. Don't fight with your back to a wall, or K'Sante R All Out can knock you through terrain.

Mordekaiser.build: Mordekaiser's main abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Since you also have to withstand his basic attacks, consider armor and ways to reduce his attack speed. If Mordekaiser W Indestructible's healing becomes a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Mordekaiser.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, close in, and stun Mordekaiser with an empowered basic attack, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Fit in basic attacks, then recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the marked target to deal damage and heal. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter during the Volibear Q Thundering Smash stun and enter its blast radius to get the shield.
Mordekaiser.escape: Mordekaiser has no mobility ability, so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp going down creates an opportunity to close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't engage alone while separated from your allies.
Mordekaiser.fight: Trade briefly and back off before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. If you can take a longer fight, build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm in advance, then get on Mordekaiser with Volibear Q Thundering Smash after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down. Don't dump your damage right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible's shield activates.
Mordekaiser.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana. Trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready. It's a good time when the enemy wave is pushed toward your turret and you have a long distance to chase. Manage your spacing in front of Mordekaiser so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can't pull you in and let him hit you repeatedly.
Mordekaiser.phase: Volibear is strong in close-range trades early, but conserve mana before learning several abilities. In mid game, when Volibear W Frenzied Maul is empowered and you've learned Volibear R Stormbringer, turn trades and dives into objectives. Later, defensive items and healing reduction make it hard to survive for long on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can't pull several of you in. After your team starts a fight and the enemy's abilities are down, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer or hold the front with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't go in first where you could be isolated.
Mordekaiser.watch: Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can pull in several people, so don't group with allies in front of him. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, so trade briefly and back off; once it activates, create distance. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone expecting help from your team.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main source of damage. Armor won't block the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire and R Fury of the Sands, so don't linger in Nasus E Spirit Fire and be wary of choices that only add a lot of health.
Nasus.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and close in, then stun Nasus with an empowered basic attack within range and use Volibear W Frenzied Maul to mark him. Follow with basic attacks, then recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the same target for empowered damage and healing. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter during the stun and stand in its blast radius to get the shield.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no way to create distance on his own besides Flash, so quickly close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash when you have a chance to force him to use Flash. After Nasus uses W Wither, don't chase alone while caught in its slow; look for an engage when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready.
Nasus.fight: Build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm in advance, and place Volibear E Sky Splitter during the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, don't continue fighting without a clear advantage.
Nasus.laning: Push the lane to Nasus's turret so he can't freely last-hit with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Let the lane push toward you and pressure his last hits, then look for a chance to catch him with Volibear Q Thundering Smash near your turret. Nasus has no escape besides Flash, so ask your jungler to gank as well.
Nasus.phase: In mid game, use the turret disable from Volibear R Stormbringer to secure your lead with dives and objectives. Nasus's stacks keep growing over time, putting you at a disadvantage, so it's important to keep him from scaling into late game.
Nasus.teamfight: Don't stand in front of Nasus for a long time while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance and let it run out. After your team starts a fight and the enemy uses their abilities, enter the back line with Volibear R Stormbringer while you have stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm. If you don't have an angle to jump into the back line, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the front with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement and attack speed, so don't stay on Nasus trading basic attacks while affected. Leave the area of Nasus E Spirit Fire, which reduces your armor. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, watch out for its max-health-based damage and increased defenses. Avoid fighting until it ends unless you have a clear advantage in numbers and firepower.

Ornn.build: The first item to purchase cannot be determined from the information provided. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so do not focus on only one resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your max health, so be wary of stacking health alone.
Ornn.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash to approach, stun with the empowered attack, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Place Volibear E Sky Splitter where the stun lands to deal damage and gain a shield, weave in basic attacks, then recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the marked target. When engaging with Volibear R Stormbringer, stun with Volibear Q Thundering Smash's empowered attack after landing.
Ornn.escape: If only Ornn E Searing Charge is down, Ornn can still escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, so check his remaining mobility. In particular, close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, engage after the effect ends.
Ornn.fight: Look for an opening to engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash after Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are down. If Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, keep your distance first. Build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm just before the fight, and fight long enough to recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on a marked target.
Ornn.laning: Pressure Ornn early while his damage is low, but farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana. Trade when the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret and Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. If Ornn tries to craft an item in lane with Ornn P Living Forge, engage to interrupt him.
Ornn.phase: Early on, Volibear can pressure Ornn with strong melee trades while Ornn's damage is low. In the mid game, use the turret disable from Volibear R Stormbringer to get ahead with dives and objectives. Late game, Ornn's items and his allies' Masterwork upgrades stack up, making it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone, so build on your mid-game lead.
Ornn.teamfight: Avoid the line between the spirit summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn, and watch the path Ornn will use to headbutt it back after it passes. Once your allies start a fight and the enemy has used their abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer and lock down a carry. If the enemy team is not grouped, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Ornn.watch: Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture leaves a pillar that Ornn E Searing Charge can collide with, so move away from the pillar and walls toward open ground. If Ornn W Bellows Breath's final flame hits you and makes you Brittle, create distance and wait for the effect to end. Dodge the spirit summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God to the side, and stay out of the line Ornn will use to headbutt it back.

Pantheon.build: Prioritize armor against Pantheon's main ability damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on max health, so avoid stacking health alone. Pantheon's high armor reduces Volibear's main physical damage, so include penetration and make use of the max-health damage from Volibear E Sky Splitter.
Pantheon.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash to approach, then stun Pantheon with the empowered attack in range. Place Volibear E Sky Splitter where the stun lands, mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, weave in basic attacks, then recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking you from the front, wait for it to end or deal damage from the side.
Pantheon.escape: Consider engaging when Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, and prioritize the window before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back up. Close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, and use Volibear R Stormbringer to close the gap when Pantheon's mobility is down and he has no escape route.
Pantheon.fight: After Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, stun him, and place Volibear E Sky Splitter where the stun lands. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, stop attacking from the front and attack after it ends, or move to the side. Mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, weave in basic attacks, then recast it on the same target for damage and healing.
Pantheon.laning: Use minions as cover from Pantheon Q Comet Spear, farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, and manage your mana. Look to trade when the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret and Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's impact falls off late game, but once the enemy has defensive items and Grievous Wounds, Volibear also has a hard time surviving on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone.
Pantheon.teamfight: When the warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall's landing appears, walk out of the landing area. Once your allies start a fight and the enemy has used their abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer and lock down a carry; fill the stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in. If the enemy team is not spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted champion, so do not step into its range first. Watch for attacks and abilities empowered by Pantheon P Mortal Will, and use minions as cover from Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Do not attack from the front while Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active; wait for it to end or move around to the side.

Poppy.build: Prioritize armor against Poppy's main damage from Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on max health, so do not rely on stacking health alone. Do not prioritize magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash to approach and stun her with the empowered attack. Place Volibear E Sky Splitter where the stun lands, mark her with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, then weave in basic attacks and recast W for healing.
Poppy.escape: The moment after you make Poppy use Poppy E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the gap.
Poppy.fight: Engage after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Use the movement speed from Volibear Q Thundering Smash to get in range and stun her with the empowered attack, then mark her with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and recast it for damage and healing. When Poppy is low on health, her armor and magic resistance increase, so account for the damage needed to finish her before fighting.
Poppy.laning: Fight in open ground without a wall behind you to avoid the stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge. When Poppy's shield drops, step on it first to prevent her from gaining the shield. Manage your mana and trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up, especially when the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret.
Poppy.phase: Volibear has strong melee trades early, but conserve mana before you have several abilities. Late game, enemy defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on W's healing alone.
Poppy.teamfight: Engage after your allies start a fight and Poppy's disruption abilities have been used. Wait before dashing with Volibear R Stormbringer while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, and avoid facing Poppy when she charges Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. If the enemy team is not spread out, save R and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Poppy.watch: Do not dash with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. Stand in open ground, since Poppy E Heroic Charge can stun you against a wall. If the first hit of Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, immediately walk out of the remaining zone. If Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move to the side rather than facing her.

Renekton.build: Renekton's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. If the healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek is a problem, fit Executioner's Calling between core items and keep Grievous Wounds applied with Volibear's basic attacks and W Frenzied Maul.
Renekton.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash to approach and stun with the empowered attack, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul and follow with a basic attack. Recast W on the same target while the mark remains. Land Volibear E Sky Splitter on the Q stun and stay within its blast radius to gain the shield.
Renekton.escape: The window to engage is after Renekton uses E Slice and Dice to disengage or spends the stun from W Ruthless Predator. Close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash then, and follow with Volibear R Stormbringer if needed.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton has no Fury or right after he has used Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice. Engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun him, then recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the same target you marked with it for damage and healing.
Renekton.laning: Adjust your position; standing in or behind a minion wave gives Renekton a platform to engage with E Slice and Dice. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana. Start a trade with Volibear Q Thundering Smash when the enemy wave is pushing in and you can catch Renekton near your turret.
Renekton.phase: Make use of Volibear's mid-game opportunities to dive and take objectives, and do not rely on W Frenzied Maul's healing alone to survive late game.
Renekton.teamfight: After your allies start a fight and Renekton uses his key abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer and lock down a carry. Build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in to deal damage to nearby enemies too. If the enemy team is spread out, save R and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is above or near half, watch for an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of its range. Empowered W breaks the shield from Volibear E Sky Splitter first, so do not try to block the combo with your shield.

Riven.build: All of Riven's damage is physical, so buy armor items first. If Riven gets ahead, move defensive items earlier in your build, and get enough health to avoid being finished by Riven R Blade of the Exile while low.
Riven.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash to approach and stun Riven with the empowered attack in range. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to mark her, place Volibear E Sky Splitter where the stun lands, then weave in basic attacks and recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul. You need to be inside the lightning strike area to receive Volibear E Sky Splitter's shield.
Riven.escape: Do not engage just because Riven E Valor is down; close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash after Riven has also fully spent Q Broken Wings. If Riven dashes in first, use the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash immediately after she engages to interrupt her remaining attacks.
Riven.fight: The chance to counterattack is right after Riven uses Q Broken Wings on minions or spends it to engage. When she gets on top of you, stun her with Volibear Q Thundering Smash's empowered attack to interrupt her remaining combo, then mark her with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and recast it for damage and healing.
Riven.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana. Trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. Look for a situation where the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret so you can keep Riven close for longer. If Riven uses Q Broken Wings to clear the wave, move forward during its downtime.
Riven.phase: Volibear has strong melee trades early, but conserve mana before you have several abilities. In the mid game, when Volibear W Frenzied Maul has scaled up and he has learned Volibear R Stormbringer, look for fights and dives while Riven's mobility is down. Late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone, so make use of your strong mid-game window.
Riven.teamfight: Engage after your allies start a fight and Riven has used her abilities. If Riven approaches, interrupt her combo with the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, and overlap Volibear E Sky Splitter with the stun to use its slow and shield.
