If the enemy team is spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings can engage with chained dashes and a knock-up, while Riven W Ki Burst can interrupt Volibear's counterattack with a stun. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase, and its execute damage based on missing health becomes dangerous, so create distance until it expires.

Rumble.build: Rumble's main damage is magic, so get magic resistance items earlier. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: Approach with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun Rumble with the empowered attack, then place Volibear E Sky Splitter where the stun lands and mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Weave in basic attacks, then recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the marked Rumble for damage and healing.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility ability, so the chance to engage is after he uses Rumble W Scrap Shield and its movement speed boost is down. Close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash after you dodge the second shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon or the harpoons have been used.
Rumble.fight: Trade when Rumble is in a position where he has to walk forward and Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready. Wait briefly for Rumble W Scrap Shield's shield to expire, then engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and fight within the shield area of Volibear E Sky Splitter.
Rumble.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; avoid staying exposed to Rumble Q Flamespitter for long. Look for a situation where the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret and Rumble has walked forward, then catch him with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Rumble.phase: Volibear has strong melee trades early, but conserve mana before you have several abilities and avoid taking Rumble Q Flamespitter for long. In the mid game, when Volibear W Frenzied Maul has gained several ranks and he has learned Volibear R Stormbringer, cement your lead with dives and objectives. Late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone.
Rumble.teamfight: After your allies start a fight and the enemy, including Rumble, has used their abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer. Build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in to hit nearby enemies too. If you have no angle to jump onto the backline, hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on max health while you stay close, so do not take the damage while fighting for too long. If you are hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, create distance before the second harpoon adds another slow and magic resistance reduction. Do not commit all your damage right after Rumble W Scrap Shield is activated, while its shield is up.

Sett.build: Prioritize armor against Sett's basic attacks and Sett Q Knuckle Down, and consider options that reduce attack speed. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on max health, so avoid stacking health alone. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so dodging to the side comes first.
Sett.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash to approach and stun Sett with the empowered basic attack, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Place Volibear E Sky Splitter where the stun lands, continue with basic attacks, then recast Volibear W Frenzied Maul on Sett while he is marked to heal. If Sett W Haymaker fires, dodge sideways from its center.
Sett.escape: If Sett E Facebreaker is down, there is less need to worry about being stunned. If Sett E Facebreaker is still available, position yourself and approach so enemies are not positioned on both sides of Sett.
Sett.fight: Right after dealing heavy damage, move away from the center of Sett W Haymaker, then go back in once his Grit fades.
Sett.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana. Trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. A good opportunity is when the enemy wave is pushing toward your turret and you can keep Sett close for longer. If a fight is likely, save your first Volibear W Frenzied Maul instead of using it on minions.
Sett.phase: In the mid game, use the power from Volibear W Frenzied Maul being stronger and having Volibear R Stormbringer to dive and take objectives. Late game, defensive items and Grievous Wounds make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone.
Sett.teamfight: After your allies start a fight and the enemy has used their abilities, engage with Volibear R Stormbringer and lock down a carry. Fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm before going in to damage nearby enemies too. Dodge the center of Sett W Haymaker, and watch your position so Sett R The Show Stopper does not grab you and throw you toward your allies.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker is especially dangerous right after he has taken a lot of damage. After dealing heavy damage, briefly create distance and wait for his Grit to fade; if he fires, dodge sideways from the center of the aim line. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when enemies are on both sides of him, so do not get caught between minions and Sett.

Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity to deal with Shen E Shadow Dash's taunt. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don't focus on just one type of resistance. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Shen.combo: When Shen E Shadow Dash is down, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, close in, and stun him with the empowered attack. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to mark him, weave in a basic attack, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the marked target for damage and healing. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, wait to use basic attacks and rely on ability damage.
Shen.escape: The moment Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your window to engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Shen R Stand United is also available, don't go too deep just because Shen E Shadow Dash is down. Before Shen R Stand United is ready again, you can close the distance with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer.
Shen.fight: Immediately after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and land the stun. Immediately before engaging, attack minions to build stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm's attack speed. Time Volibear E Sky Splitter with the stun to deal damage and gain a shield.
Shen.laning: Take the lead with early melee trades, but farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to manage your mana. Trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready, especially when the enemy wave is pushing toward your tower. Then push the lane and keep Shen occupied with CS, so he loses ground when he uses Shen R Stand United to influence another lane.
Shen.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, while Shen is relatively weak in lane, but Volibear must manage his mana. In mid game, Volibear W Frenzied Maul is stronger, and the power from learning Volibear R Stormbringer can be used for dives and objectives. In late game, defensive items and healing reduction make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone.
Shen.teamfight: Alert your team immediately when Shen is missing or you see Shen R Stand United channeling, and finish the fight or avoid starting one before he arrives. In teamfights, wait for an ally to engage and the enemy to use their abilities, then enter with Volibear R Stormbringer and catch a carry. If the enemy team isn't split up, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Shen.watch: Dodge Shen E Shadow Dash's taunt. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, don't rush in the Volibear Q Thundering Smash stun-enhanced basic attack.

Singed.build: Singed's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Singed E Fling deals damage based on your max health, so instead of stacking health alone, also get movement speed to escape Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach, then stun Singed with the empowered attack once he's in range. When diving a tower, land with Volibear R Stormbringer to disable the tower and engage only when Singed is immobilized or has no way to dodge.
Singed.escape: Singed has no mobility ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash after bypassing Singed W Mega Adhesive or once Singed E Fling is down. Don't step on the adhesive, since you can't rely on Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer to engage or escape while on it.
Singed.fight: After that, engage once Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready and you can bypass Singed W Mega Adhesive. Rather than chasing for a long time through Singed Q Poison Trail, catch him briefly, deal damage, and end the trade.
Singed.laning: Whittle down Singed's health early to force him to recall. In general, farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to manage your mana, and trade with Volibear Q Thundering Smash when the enemy wave pushes toward your tower. If a fight is likely, don't use the first cast of Volibear W Frenzied Maul on a minion.
Singed.phase: In mid game, Volibear W Frenzied Maul is stronger, and the power from learning Volibear R Stormbringer can be used for dives and objectives. As Singed gets harder to catch in late game and healing reduction makes it hard to rely on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone, turn your mid-game lead into map pressure.
Singed.teamfight: Don't chase Singed to the end; attack his allies while he's held in place by Volibear Q Thundering Smash. After an ally engages and the enemy uses their abilities, enter the backline with Volibear R Stormbringer while Volibear P The Relentless Storm is fully stacked. If the enemy team isn't split up, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Singed.watch: Even at low health, Singed can escape while leaving Singed Q Poison Trail behind, so don't chase unless you have enough damage to finish him for sure. You can't dash with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer while on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and if Singed E Fling hits you there, you'll be rooted.

Skarner.build: Build magic resistance first to account for the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. If you need to remove Skarner R Impale's suppression, consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach to stun him with the empowered attack. Cast Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stunned target, mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, then weave in basic attacks. While the mark is active, use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again for empowered damage and healing.
Skarner.escape: If you are hit by an immobilizing effect before Volibear Q Thundering Smash stuns the target, its cooldown resets. But if Skarner R Impale catches you, you can't remove the suppression with a mobility ability, so stay wary of its range.
Skarner.fight: As soon as Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, stun him, and mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul. Follow up with basic attacks, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the marked target for damage and healing. Be wary of long trades where you keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Skarner.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to manage your mana, and trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready. Look for a trade when the enemy wave pushes forward and you can catch Skarner near your tower. If a fight is likely, save the first cast of Volibear W Frenzied Maul instead of using it on a minion.
Skarner.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, but must conserve mana while fighting. In mid game, as Volibear W Frenzied Maul scales and you learn Volibear R Stormbringer, get ahead with dives and objectives. As time passes, Skarner builds tank items and counters Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing, making it harder for Volibear to survive.
Skarner.teamfight: After an ally engages and the enemy uses abilities like Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer. Skarner R Impale can't be interrupted with a stun, so watch where your allied carries could be pulled and the edges of the Dragon and Baron pits. If the enemy team is split up, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can pass through terrain to grab you and stun you when he collides with a wall, so don't stand with your back to a wall. Skarner R Impale's suppression can't be removed by Volibear Q Thundering Smash's stun or Volibear R Stormbringer's leap, so don't stay in range for long.

TahmKench.build: Tahm Kench's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Fit Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin. Tahm Kench has high armor, so Volibear's physical damage is less effective; consider penetration as well.
TahmKench.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach, then stun Tahm Kench with the empowered attack once he's in range. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, a basic attack, and a second Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the same target. Time Volibear E Sky Splitter with the stun, and stand in the blast radius to gain a shield.
TahmKench.escape: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, it is harder for him to engage or escape, so look for a chance to close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, delay your engage until the stacks disappear. Also account for Tahm Kench R Devour while he can still use it.
TahmKench.fight: Engage when Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has no stacks and Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready. Stun him with the empowered attack from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, and weave in basic attacks before using Volibear W Frenzied Maul a second time on the same target. Tahm Kench E Thick Skin can convert damage into a shield or healing, so avoid short trades where you hit him a little and back off.
TahmKench.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to manage your mana, and try to trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready. Look for a trade when the enemy wave pushes toward your tower and you can keep Tahm Kench occupied for a while. Immediately before engaging, attack minions to fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm.
TahmKench.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, but must conserve mana until he learns several abilities. In late game, defensive items and healing reduction make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone, so secure your lead with mid-game dives and objectives.
TahmKench.teamfight: Tahm Kench has high armor and plenty of healing, so pressure the carry he is protecting instead of trying to kill him first. However, if Tahm Kench R Devour is available, he can swallow the carry, so check before using a finishing ability. After an ally engages and the enemy uses their abilities, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer. If you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your allies to avoid the area-of-effect knock-up.
TahmKench.watch: If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, back off and wait for the stacks to disappear. A third basic attack or Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash will stun you and create an opening for Tahm Kench R Devour. If you see the dive animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, move away from the landing point.

Teemo.build: Teemo's main damage from Q Blinding Dart, E Toxic Shot, and R Noxious Trap is magic, so build magic resistance first. Prepare Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap from key paths.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach to stun him with the empowered attack. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and basic attacks, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on Teemo while the mark remains. Time Volibear E Sky Splitter with Volibear Q Thundering Smash's stun.
Teemo.escape: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, you have a window to engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. Teemo W Move Quick increases his movement speed, so if you use Volibear Q Thundering Smash to close the distance, stick to him instead of landing a quick hit and backing off.
Teemo.fight: Take the chance to trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Then close in fully with Volibear Q Thundering Smash to stun him, and use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again on the marked target for damage and healing. It helps to fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm before engaging.
Teemo.laning: Normally, farm outside Teemo's attack range and poke with Volibear E Sky Splitter. Engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash only right after Teemo uses Q Blinding Dart or when he steps forward. Look to trade when the enemy wave is pushing toward your tower and you can keep Teemo occupied for a while.
Teemo.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, but keep your distance so Teemo can't poke you freely. In mid game, build your lead with dives and objectives. In late game, don't rely on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone to survive through defensive items and healing reduction.
Teemo.teamfight: After an ally engages and the enemy uses their abilities, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer and catch the backline. Fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm before engaging, and if the enemy is split up, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the frontline with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. In front of objectives and in narrow passages, use Oracle Lens to spot and clear Teemo R Noxious Trap.
Teemo.watch: If you are hit by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, your basic attacks are nullified, so avoid engaging to stun him with Volibear Q Thundering Smash's empowered attack. Teemo E Toxic Shot deals poison damage even from a single basic attack, so stay out of range if you aren't ready to engage. Also watch for paths where Teemo R Noxious Trap could be placed and bushes without vision.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks, and consider options that reduce attack speed. Trundle has strong healing, so fit Executioner's Calling between core items to maintain healing reduction. Trundle R Subjugate reduces resistances and deals damage based on max health, so don't try to counter it by stacking only resistances or health.
Trundle.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approach, then stun Trundle with the empowered basic attack once he's in range. If you use the first cast of Volibear W Frenzied Maul on a minion, the timing for getting its second-cast effects on a champion will be off, so save it before a fight.
Trundle.escape: When Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down, you have a chance to engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so once Trundle W Frozen Domain has also expired, close the distance with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer.
Trundle.fight: Back out of Trundle W Frozen Domain and wait out its duration, then engage when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready. If Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down, close the distance in open terrain with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer.
Trundle.laning: Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul to manage your mana, and trade with Volibear Q Thundering Smash when the enemy wave pushes toward your tower. Trundle P King's Tribute heals him when nearby units die, so don't drag out a fight where you only chip away at his health in front of a large wave. If you lower his health, capitalize immediately or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.phase: As Volibear W Frenzied Maul ranks up and you learn Volibear R Stormbringer, secure your lead with dives and objectives. After Trundle learns Trundle R Subjugate, don't face him alone in a side lane, and in late game don't rely on Volibear W Frenzied Maul's healing alone to survive.
Trundle.teamfight: After an ally starts a fight and the enemy uses their abilities, enter the backline with Volibear R Stormbringer and catch a carry. Target someone else instead of fighting Trundle alone while Trundle R Subjugate is active, and fully stack Volibear P The Relentless Storm before engaging.
Trundle.watch: Attack speed and healing are increased on Trundle W Frozen Domain, so don't fight inside it; back off and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks the path and slows, so avoid fighting in narrow paths and move to the side as soon as the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, he steals your resistances and becomes tanky, so create distance.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr. Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals mixed damage, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle is a problem, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Udyr.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, close in, and stun with an empowered basic attack in range. Follow with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, a basic attack, then a second Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the marked target. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stunned target and stand in the blast radius to gain the shield.
Udyr.escape: Right after Udyr uses Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to engage with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer. Immobilizing effects do not work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is awakened, so apply Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun after the awakening ends. If you may need to escape, save Volibear Q Thundering Smash instead of trying to run on foot.
Udyr.fight: Bait out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, then close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. Stun Udyr after Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s awakening ends. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, press the attack without giving Udyr time to heal. Immediately before the fight, hit a minion or jungle monster to build stacks for Volibear P The Relentless Storm.
Udyr.laning: Udyr reveals himself through ganks from the jungle, so secure vision at key paths and jungle entrances, and don’t push up in lane when Udyr is out of sight. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready. Aim for a favorable setup where the enemy wave pushes toward your turret and you can keep Udyr close for longer.
Udyr.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, but you need to conserve mana before learning several abilities. In the late game, defensive items and healing reduction make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone, so focus on mid-game dives and objectives.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t force a fight to take down Udyr first when Udyr has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Once your team engages and the enemy’s abilities have been spent, use Volibear R Stormbringer to reach the vulnerable enemies behind Udyr. If the enemy team isn’t spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the front with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede closes the gap quickly and stuns, so keep your distance right after Udyr activates a new stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about extended fights. Once you’ve taken the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, retaliate or disengage while it can’t be applied to you again.

Urgot.build: Build armor first against Urgot to handle his main damage. Urgot has high armor, so add penetration to deal more damage.
Urgot.combo: To engage, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, get in range, and stun with an empowered basic attack. Overlap Volibear E Sky Splitter’s lightning strike with the stun, mark Urgot with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, then weave in basic attacks before using it again.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility tool, so close the gap right after he uses it with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge is also down, you can engage while avoiding its heavy slow and being targeted by Urgot W Purge.
Urgot.fight: Right after you bait out Urgot E Disdain is your chance to close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. Stun Urgot with an empowered basic attack from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, then use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again to deal damage and heal. Avoid fights that drag on and expose you to Urgot P Echoing Flames multiple times.
Urgot.laning: Against Urgot, prioritize farming and wait just outside his short range instead of forcing a direct fight. When it’s hard to get close, poke with Volibear E Sky Splitter, but save mana and the shield for your engage. After Urgot steps forward and uses a poke ability or Urgot E Disdain, close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash near your turret if possible.
Urgot.phase: Volibear is strong once he gets close in the early game, but it’s hard to fight Urgot head-on for long, and using several abilities quickly drains your mana. In the late game, defensive items and healing reduction make it hard to rely on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone, so secure your advantage with mid-game objectives.
Urgot.teamfight: Once your team engages and Urgot has used his abilities, enter with Volibear R Stormbringer. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so you can stand in the front line to keep your allies behind you from being pulled. If the enemy team isn’t spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the front with Volibear Q Thundering Smash.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stay beside Urgot for long. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, it heavily slows you and marks you for Urgot W Purge, so dodge it as it comes in; if it hits, escape with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of range before you enter its execute threshold.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Attack speed reduction also slows the return timing of Yasuo’s basic attacks and whirlwind.
Yasuo.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, close in, and stun Yasuo with an empowered basic attack in range. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter on that spot, mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, then weave in basic attacks before using a second Volibear W Frenzied Maul on the same target.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his whirlwind, his knock-up stacks reset, giving you an opportunity to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t go in just because he used it once. Close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield by dealing damage once, then trade in earnest after the shield disappears. When Yasuo has thrown his whirlwind and has no way to knock you up, close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash to stun him and overlap Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stunned location.
Yasuo.laning: Thin the wave and pull it toward your side to reduce the minions Yasuo can use to dash in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; trade near your turret when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up.
Yasuo.phase: Volibear is strong in melee trades early, but mana runs out quickly before you learn several abilities, so choose your trades carefully. In the mid game, once Volibear W Frenzied Maul has gained several ranks and you’ve learned Volibear R Stormbringer, look for dives and objectives. In the late game, defensive items and healing reduction make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone.
Yasuo.teamfight: Once your team engages and enemy abilities, including Yasuo’s whirlwind, have been spent, use Volibear R Stormbringer to reach the back line.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move sideways to dodge as Yasuo approaches. After two hits, its whirlwind knocks you airborne and can lead into Yasuo R Last Breath, so be ready to dodge when you see the stack effect.

Yone.build: Prioritize attack speed reduction to slow the cooldown cycles of Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone W Spirit Cleave. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t skew your resistances toward just one type. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Yone.combo: When Yone engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, close in, and stun him with an empowered basic attack. While the mark remains, use Volibear W Frenzied Maul again to deal damage and heal.
Yone.escape: Once Yone has used Yone Q Mortal Steel and Yone E Soul Unbound to engage, you have a chance to close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If only one mobility tool is down, Yone can escape with the other, so especially look for an opening before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up. Use Volibear R Stormbringer when Yone is already locked down or has no escape route.
Yone.fight: When Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, stun him with Volibear Q Thundering Smash to stop his return and start the trade. Don’t enter range first while Yone Q Mortal Steel’s whirlwind is ready. Immediately before the fight, hit minions to build attack speed stacks for Volibear P The Relentless Storm.
Yone.laning: After that, trade when the enemy wave has pushed toward your turret and Volibear Q Thundering Smash is back up. Farm with Volibear W Frenzied Maul and manage your mana; if a fight is likely, save its first cast for a champion.
Yone.phase: In the late game, enemy defensive items and healing reduction make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield doesn’t grow, and don’t stand alone at the very back of your formation in case of Yone R Fate Sealed. Once your team engages and the enemy uses their abilities, use Volibear R Stormbringer to dive in and pin down a damage dealer. If you need to stop Yone while he is in Yone E Soul Unbound, save Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun for then.
Yone.watch: If Yone keeps hitting minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare his whirlwind, wait outside its range until the stacks disappear. After Yone uses Yone E Soul Unbound to engage, save Volibear Q Thundering Smash’s stun to stop his return. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so don’t stand alone at the very back of your formation in team fights.

Yorick.build: Build armor first to handle Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ damage. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites is a problem, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Yorick.combo: Activate Volibear Q Thundering Smash, close in, and stun Yorick with an empowered basic attack in range. Then attack in this order: Volibear W Frenzied Maul, basic attack, and Volibear W Frenzied Maul again. Drop Volibear E Sky Splitter on the stunned Yorick, and stay in the blast radius to get the shield. When diving, land with Volibear R Stormbringer, then follow with Volibear Q Thundering Smash → Volibear W Frenzied Maul → Volibear E Sky Splitter.
Yorick.escape: Right after Yorick E Mourning Mist misses is your chance to engage. Yorick has no mobility ability, so if Yorick W Dark Procession is also down, close the gap with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and hold him there. If Yorick W Dark Procession is still available, look for a path to break through the wall or cross it with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer before going in.
Yorick.fight: Fight when Yorick E Mourning Mist misses or is down and there are few graves and Mist Walkers nearby. Close in with Volibear Q Thundering Smash and stun Yorick with an empowered basic attack, mark him with Volibear W Frenzied Maul, then use it again to deal damage and heal. Building stacks for Volibear P The Relentless Storm before engaging can increase your damage.
Yorick.laning: Don’t start a fight where Yorick has built up many graves. Push the lane so Yorick can’t build graves by killing minions on his side and has to let them die under his turret. Look to trade when Volibear Q Thundering Smash is ready and Yorick E Mourning Mist is down.
Yorick.phase: Volibear is strong in early melee trades, but mana runs out quickly before you learn several abilities, so don’t fight for long where graves have built up. In the mid game, once Volibear W Frenzied Maul is stronger and you’ve learned Volibear R Stormbringer, look for dives and objectives. In the late game, defensive items and healing reduction make it hard to survive on Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing alone, so respond to Yorick’s side lane pressure while also watching for objective trades elsewhere.
Yorick.teamfight: Once your team engages and the enemy has used their abilities, use Volibear R Stormbringer to reach and hold the back-line damage dealers. Build stacks for Volibear P The Relentless Storm before engaging to damage nearby enemies as well. If the enemy team isn’t spread out, save Volibear R Stormbringer and hold the front with Q Thundering Smash.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you and deals damage based on your maximum health, so dodge its trajectory to avoid being forced into an engage. If Yorick W Dark Procession traps you, attack the wall to break it or cross it with Volibear Q Thundering Smash or Volibear R Stormbringer. If the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
